desc:
NEW CODES AT 150 LIKES 👍


Added Multiplayer support!

🐔 Chicken ragdoll physics: every hit sends them flopping, limping and flying in a different way!

🆕 NEW: X-Ray Vitals: see broken bones and a racing heartbeat
🎯 Real ragdoll physics: every part reacts on its own
🐾 Hit a leg and they limp, break both and they crawl
✋ Grab chickens, swing them and throw them
🔫 30+ weapons unlocked by kills: Sniper, Minigun, Flamethrower, Crossbow, Katana, Shotgun, .50 Cal and more
🌪️ Powers: Tornado, Black Hole, Deep Freeze, Chain Lightning, Ground Slam
💣 Airstrikes, B-52 bombers and the NUKE
🚜 Drive the Combine Harvester and the Excavator (free test drive every day)
⚡ Shock chickens back to life with the Defibrillator
🎈 Balloon Gun, Pitchfork, launch pads and chicken races
🎬 Film Maker: direct, slow down and save your own chicken movies
🏆 Daily challenges, rewards and leaderboards

UPDATES Every Friday 

📱 Phone, tablet, PC and console
